verification.precondition: A new live Survey workspace retains an exact generic SourceSnapshot whose UTF-8 entry begins with a BOM or contains NUL, plus the exact Survey policy head.
verification.stimulus: Advance the Survey initialization adapter with a ready dependency result.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The sealed initialization authority returns SURVEY_INITIALIZATION_SOURCE_TEXT_UNSUITABLE before command derivation.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The adapter observes one preimage read, zero execute calls, zero machine-state derivations, and a byte-identical revision-zero store with no AT01 or T02 edge.
verification.forbiddenMutation: The adapter must not append a journal record, advance authoring or phase state, create an Assignment, normalize the SourceSnapshot bytes, or weaken the generic 16 MiB SourceSnapshot authority.

behavior: sealed initialization authority rejects BOM and NUL SurveyFrame source text before AT01
